python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,zlib,struct,hmac,os
from pathlib import Path
srcp=Path('store/jobs/j000315/out/seed-serializer-source-contexts.jsonl')
records=[]
for line in srcp.open(errors='replace'):
    try: records.append(json.loads(line))
    except Exception: pass
texts=[r.get('context','') for r in records if isinstance(r,dict)]
joined='\n'.join(texts)
# Search literal source relationships without retaining source text or any secret values.
checks={
 'expand_shrink_2pow15': bool(re.search(r'\{expand:([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*),shrink:([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\}=r\(1536\)\(Math\.pow\(2,15\)\)',joined)),
 'writer_gzip_before_expand': bool(re.search(r'gzipSync\([^)]*\).*?writeSeco|writeSeco.*?gzipSync',joined,re.S)),
 'reader_shrink_then_gunzip': bool(re.search(r'gunzipSync\([^)]*\([^)]*\)\)',joined)),
 'unlock_fromBuffer_readSeco': bool(re.search(r'fromBuffer\([^)]*readSeco|fromBuffer\(await[^;]*readSeco',joined,re.S)),
 'serializer_concat_seed_entropy': bool(re.search(r'Buffer\.concat\(\[.*?seed.*?entropy.*?\]\)',joined,re.I|re.S)),
 'frombuffer_entropy_lengths': all(x in joined for x in ('16','32','fromBuffer')),
}
payload=Path('store/jobs/j000302/out/seed-authenticated-payload.bin').read_bytes()
retained=Path('store/jobs/j000319/out/serialized-seed-4.bin').read_bytes()
hits=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(b'\x1f\x8b\x08'),payload)]
rows=[]
for off in hits:
    d=zlib.decompressobj(31)
    plain=d.decompress(payload[off:])+d.flush()
    consumed=len(payload)-off-len(d.unused_data)
    # Parse RFC1952 trailer in the consumed member and check CRC/ISIZE independently.
    trailer=payload[off+consumed-8:off+consumed]
    crc,isize=struct.unpack('<II',trailer)
    rows.append({'offset':off,'eof':d.eof,'consumed':consumed,'decompressed_bytes':len(plain),'no_unconsumed_tail':not d.unconsumed_tail,'crc_valid':(zlib.crc32(plain)&0xffffffff)==crc,'isize_valid':(len(plain)&0xffffffff)==isize,'equals_retained_serialized_seed':hmac.compare_digest(plain,retained),'layout_64_plus_16':len(plain)==80})
out={'source_records':len(records),'source_checks':checks,'payload_bytes':len(payload),'gzip_header_offsets':hits,'members':rows,'retained_bytes':len(retained),'secret_values_emitted':False}
Path(os.environ['OUT'],'independent-seed-serialization-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
